proof_body:
by
  intro f g a b hd hg hp
  have hcf : ContinuousOn f (Set.uIcc a b) := fun x hx => (hd x hx).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (f := fun x => Real.log (f x)) (fun x hx => (hd x hx).log (hp x hx).ne') (ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable (hg.div hcf fun x hx => (hp x hx).ne'))
target_source: ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f (g x) x) → ContinuousOn g (Set.uIcc a b) → (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, 0 < f x) → ∫ x in a..b, g x / f x = Real.log (f b) - Real.log (f a)
